description: Selective waste collection survey dataset, Hungary is published by Andrea Magda, Nagy; Konka, Boglákra; Darida, Zsuzsa; Tobak, Júlia; Töreki, Stefánia Matild; Laszlo, Veronika. The questionnaire records waste-sorting attitudes, norms, barriers and demographic characteristics. Its stated coverage is Hungary; an online survey in 2026. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata and lists XLSX resources; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is cc-by-4.0. Online participation does not establish a representative population sample. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
